item.title: Michigan synagogue attacker committed 'Hezbollah-inspired act of terrorism': FBI
item.summary: The man armed with fireworks who rammed his truck into a West Bloomfield, Michigan, synagogue was carrying out "a Hezbollah-inspired act of terrorism," the FBI said.
